replication.target_description: Hypothetical vacation intensity of emotion DV2, predicted versus remembered actual enjoyment, Table 9b p. 41; independently adopted anticipation and retrospection temporal perspectives. Replication changes ski vacation to a general resort vacation (p. 25).

n.sample_role: Participants in two mutually exclusive between-subject vacation temporal-perspective conditions, anticipation 288 and retrospection 276.
n.exclusions: Main manuscript analytic sample after general funneling, before the supplementary additional exclusions. Only participants who had taken a vacation proceeded (p. 29). General funneling excluded inability to mentally time travel (2) or write a contemplated/recalled scenario (2), p. 38. Supplementary additional exclusions analyzed separately.

notes: Identity assessed from supplied canonical text: cover identifies Lau Tsz Chin, University of Hong Kong, 2020, title Van Boven and Ashworth (2007): Replication and extension, supervisor Dr. Gilad Feldman; provenance header names https://osf.io/ns26x and Cherry LAU Thesis Final Report.pdf. Page 3 gives the exact target original title and DOI 10.1037/0096-3445.136.2.289. This is a primary completed thesis report with methods, results and supplementary results, not a preregistration or secondary article. No PDF was supplied. Original side and unassigned fields are placeholders only. Table 9b at supplied p. 41 has one vacation DV2 comparison, consistent with the emotional-intensity description. P. 26 identifies DV2 as actual enjoyment of the imagined vacation. Analytic N derivation: 288 anticipation participants + 276 retrospection participants = 564 distinct participants. P. 29 documents independent assigned temporal conditions, with a hypothetical holiday six months in the future versus six months in the past; p. 49 identifies independent t-tests. Counts are not inferred from df or generic recruitment. Main results on p. 37 are labelled pre-exclusion, with general funneling already applied on p. 38. Supplementary p. 52 post-exclusion vacation counts 243 + 241 = 484 correspond to a different p. 58 DV2 test (d = -0.06, p = .555); do not mix them with main manuscript p. 41 values. The general-vacation modification is documented rather than treated as a different replication project.
